abstract: Teratomas are complex lesions composed of diverse tissues from all 3 germinal cell layers and may exhibit variable levels of maturity. Head and neck teratomas are most commonly cervical with the oropharynx (epignathus) being the second commonest location. In this article, clinical presentation, behaviour and associated significance of head and neck teratomas have been highlightened. Because of their obscure origin, bizarre microscopic appearance, unpredictable behaviour and often dramatic clinical presentation, a dental surgeon or a dental specialist should be aware of their clinical presentation and pathology.
abstract_ja: 奇形腫は三つの胚葉すべての組織から成る複雑な病変で、成熟度は様々である。頭頸部奇形腫は頸部に最も多く、口咽頭(epignathus)が次いで多い部位である。本論文では頭頸部奇形腫の臨床像、挙動、関連する臨床的意義を明らかにした。起源が不明瞭で、組織像が奇異で、経過が予測困難であり、劇的な臨床像を呈することもあるため、歯科医や歯科専門医はその臨床像と病理を認識しておくべきである。
